readmeHtml:
the-craft-of-selfteaching

One has no future if one couldn't teach themself[1].

自学是门手艺

没有自学能力的人没有未来

作者：李笑来

特别感谢霍炬（@virushuo）、洪强宁（@hongqn) 两位良师诤友在此书写作过程中给予我的巨大帮助！

# pseudo-code of selfteaching in Python

def teach_yourself(anything):
    while not create():
        learn()
        practice()
    return teach_yourself(another)

teach_yourself(coding)

请先行阅读 T-appendix.jupyter-installation-and-setup 以便在本地安装 Jupyterlab 而后就能用更好的体验阅读本书。

aiSummary.oneLiner: A comprehensive open-source book and curriculum on mastering the art of self-learning through Python programming.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This project provides a detailed, systematic guide to cultivating self-learning abilities, using Python as the practical medium. It breaks down complex concepts like regular expressions, BNF, decorators, and iterators into digestible lessons while simultaneously teaching meta-skills like focus management and effective communication. By treating programming not just as a technical skill but as a tool for personal growth, it helps readers escape the 'indispensable illusion' of needing a teacher. The curriculum is entirely open-source, encouraging a social approach to self-teaching via shared repositories.
keyFeatures: Python-based curriculum: Teaches essential programming concepts like regular expressions and decorators to build practical skills.
Meta-learning focus: Explicitly covers strategies for avoiding focus drift and breaking down complex topics.
Environment setup guides: Includes detailed appendices on configuring Visual Studio Code and JupyterLab.
Version control integration: Introduces Git to help learners track progress and collaborate effectively.
Open source licensing: Released under CC-BY-NC-ND, ensuring free access for all aspiring self-learners.

useCases.title: Learn programming independently
useCases.description: Master Python fundamentals from scratch without relying on traditional classroom environments.

useCases.title: Improve focus and retention
useCases.description: Apply proven meta-learning strategies to avoid distractions and thoroughly understand complex technical concepts.

useCases.title: Set up a professional environment
useCases.description: Follow comprehensive appendices to install and configure essential developer tools like VS Code and JupyterLab.

useCases.title: Collaborate with other learners
useCases.description: Use Git and GitHub to engage in social self-teaching and share progress with a broader community.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Built for self-motivated individuals who want to learn programming while simultaneously improving their general ability to acquire new skills independently. It is ideal for beginners who need a structured path and practical advice on setting up their development environment.
